name: devops-on-premise
description: Work with Azure DevOps Server, formerly known as Team Foundation Server (TFS): browse repositories, review pull requests, manage work items, and read or edit wiki pages. Not for Azure DevOps Services.

api_url.title: Azure DevOps Server project URL
api_url.description: Full project URL of your Azure DevOps Server: https://<server>/<collection>/<project>

username.title: Username (NTLM)
username.description: Windows domain user as DOMAIN\username. Leave empty when you use a Personal Access Token.

password.title: Password (NTLM)
password.description: Windows domain password. Leave empty when you use a Personal Access Token.

pat.title: Personal Access Token
pat.description: PAT for your Azure DevOps Server. Leave empty when you use username and password.
